note: Residue of the input/devices research document: it records that CNA neither ships nor parses a controller-mapping database (SDL's is the authority). At 009d40f5 that is still true for the SDL3 platform, but the native X11/Wayland evdev hub classifies nodes itself and reads community-format mappings from CNA_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG_FILE / CNA_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG, which is how generic joystick-range pads become XNA gamepads. The site described the evdev hub but not classification or mappings. Verified by reading EvdevLayout.cpp, EvdevMapping.hpp/.cpp, EvdevControllers.cpp, LinuxEvdevMappingTests.cpp and cmake/UnitTests.cmake at 009d40f5.
